$schema_note: Pinned upstream artifacts for packets/build.py. sha256 values are verified after download; license_files sha256 values are verified after extraction so a license change upstream fails the build.
generated_from: registry metadata and artifacts inspected on 2026-09-21

holidays.upstream: Vacanza Team — holidays (Open World Holidays Framework); holiday rules are encoded by the project from official gazettes and government sources
holidays.notes: Wheel imported at build time to generate calendars; requires python-dateutil and six at runtime.

python-dateutil.notes: Runtime dependency of holidays only; no data copied into packets.

six.notes: Runtime dependency of python-dateutil only; no data copied into packets.

pycountry.upstream: Debian iso-codes project (salsa.debian.org/iso-codes-team/iso-codes), which curates the ISO 3166, 4217, 639 and 15924 code lists published by their ISO maintenance agencies
pycountry.notes: Data files pycountry/databases/*.json are read directly; the Python API is not used. The artifact does not declare which iso-codes release it vendors.

us.upstream: python-us (unitedstates project; originally Sunlight Labs) — hand-maintained table of US state metadata; FIPS codes are those of the US Census Bureau / FIPS 5-2
us.notes: us/states.py is parsed with the ast module (no import; avoids the jellyfish dependency).

spdx-license-list.upstream: SPDX License List 3.28.0 (2026-02-20), published by the SPDX Project (Linux Foundation); repackaged by Sindre Sorhus
spdx-license-list.notes: readme.md in the artifact states: "Using SPDX License List version 3.28.0 (2026-02-20)".

spdx-license-ids.upstream: SPDX License List (deprecated-identifier flags), repackaged by the jslicense project
spdx-license-ids.notes: Used only for the deprecated flag. The tarball carries no LICENSE file; CC0-1.0 is declared in its package.json only.

vvo-tzdb.upstream: IANA Time Zone Database (zone names, offsets) and GeoNames (CC BY 4.0; country and city selections); generated by the tzdb project against npm tzdata 1.0.46 = IANA 2025b
vvo-tzdb.notes: raw-time-zones.json, time-zones-names.json and abbreviations.json are read directly.

tzdata-pypi.upstream: IANA Time Zone Database release 2026d (public domain), packaged for Python by the tzdata project
tzdata-pypi.notes: Used to compute 2026 UTC offsets, DST flags, link targets and country tables with the stdlib zoneinfo module. No file from this package is copied into a packet.

naics.upstream: US Census Bureau, 2017 NAICS Descriptions (2017_NAICS_Descriptions.xlsx, census.gov/naics/2017NAICS/); NAICS is maintained by the US Office of Management and Budget
naics.notes: data/2017_NAICS_Descriptions.xlsx is parsed directly with stdlib zipfile + xml; the derived JSON in the tarball is not used.

world-countries.upstream: mledoze/countries (Mohammed Le Doze and contributors), a hand-curated database keyed on ISO 3166-1
world-countries.notes: countries.json is read directly. The npm registry "license" field is empty; package.json carries a "licenses" array naming ODbL-1.0 and the tarball ships the ODbL text as LICENSE.

airport-codes.declared_license: ISC (package.json only; no LICENSE file in tarball)
airport-codes.reason: Rights and provenance unclear: README says the data is "pulled from OpenFlights.org" and its update recipe fetches jpatokal/openflights airports.dat; OpenFlights publishes that data under ODbL 1.0 + Database Contents License with attribution and share-alike obligations, which the packager cannot relicense as ISC. The tarball also ships an airports.csv with OurAirports-style columns and no statement of origin at all. Snapshot is from 2015.
